profile.headline: Engineering & Architecture | IAM | Agentic Identity | Zero Trust
profile.summary:
Full-stack development, system architecture and identity management, leveraging a wide array of technologies and methodologies to drive business objectives and deliver innovative solutions.

Currently exploring the emerging space of AI Agent Identity and Agentic AI Governance. Focusing on how autonomous agents authenticate, authorize, inherit permissions, interact with enterprise systems, and operate securely within Zero Trust environments. Interested in building enterprise-grade frameworks for AI agent lifecycle management, delegated access, policy enforcement, auditability, and machine trust.

Design Philosophy - Sleek and streamlined, my aesthetic is minimalist with a focus on clean interface.

Development Style - Iterative and developer focused, my coding style is modular, with a strong emphasis on security and scalability.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management
positions.description:
- Lead enterprise identity architecture across Azure, AWS, and GCP, defining scalable patterns for federation, SSO, SCIM provisioning, lifecycle management, and access governance across workforce, guest, vendor, and service identities.
- Drive Zero Trust and privileged access strategy, including phishing-resistant FIDO2/YubiKey authentication, Azure PIM/JIT elevation, Conditional Access, and least-privilege models for administrative and engineering environments.
- Lead IAM architecture for mergers and acquisitions (M&A), defining repeatable identity integration patterns for acquired workforces, applications, and environments. Design attribute-driven identity correlation, lifecycle and access models to securely bridge acquired-company and Autodesk identities while enabling SSO, application onboarding, policy enforcement, and progressive migration into enterprise IAM standards.
- Define enterprise IGA and access governance architecture, including RBAC/ABAC, birthright access, lifecycle automation, access certifications, exception models, and governance patterns using SailPoint and Microsoft Entra ID.
- Architect Identity-as-Code patterns for security controls such as Conditional Access using Terraform, CI/CD, GitHub, CloudBees/Jenkins, and Vault, introducing peer-reviewed and auditable identity configuration changes.
- Advance machine and workload identity strategy, evaluating service identity architectures and technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE for short-lived, verifiable workload identities and Zero Trust service-to-service authentication.
- Investigate AI-agent identity and governance, defining approaches for agent authentication, delegated authorization, lifecycle management, least privilege, auditability, impersonation controls, and AI-native IGA.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Architect | Identity and Access Management
positions.description:
- Designed and delivered Azure B2B guest identity lifecycle automation, replacing manual onboarding and offboarding with policy- and attribute-driven provisioning, deprovisioning, application access, and governance workflows.
- Engineered SailPoint/Entra lifecycle and access solutions supporting joiner/mover/leaver processes, RBAC-based access, access certifications, application onboarding, and exception handling.
- Developed identity automation frameworks for service accounts, Azure resource access, distribution-list governance, vendor access, and enterprise application provisioning, reducing manual IAM operations.
- Designed and implemented SSO and application integrations using SAML, OIDC/OAuth, SCIM, APIs, and federated authentication patterns across enterprise SaaS and cloud platforms.
- Built and maintained IAM automation and integration services using APIs, scripting, Terraform, CI/CD, and cloud-native technologies, improving reliability and repeatability of identity operations.
- Partnered with Security, IT, application owners, and business stakeholders to translate access and compliance requirements into scalable technical IAM solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Identity & Access Management (IAM) · Authorization · Digital Authentication · Azure AD · Entra ID · Software Architecture

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Stations
positions.description:
Work ranges from hacking on hardware drivers, to architecting onboard data processing and CV/ML solutions, to integrating with cloud-based services
Enable new features and products, and to support the decades-long product lifetime
Day-to-day encompass engineering IC tasks including requirements definition, scoping, architecting, coding, debugging, and even some PM’ing.

● Responsible for all the services that run on Volta’s EV charging station
● Day-to-day work ranges from hacking on hardware drivers, to architecting onboard data processing and CV/ML
solutions, to integrating with cloud-based service
● Working at all levels to get the product from concept to large scale production
● Working on creating a custom OS for the charging system using Yocto
● Working on developing Over The Air update strategies with Foundries.io
● Working on developing a touch interface for Driver’s to interact Volta’s Charging Stations using Qt.io framework
● Working on setting up manufacturing processes for large scale production of Volta’s charging Stations - EVT DVT
PVT
● Writing firmware level EOL testing for testing
● Provide subject matter expertise for Identity and Access Management
● Developed a virtual station simulator to help test station services without requiring an actual hardware
● Working very closely with Product Managers to develop new features and contributing to future product roadmaps
● Performing code reviews and managing code repositories
● Work on service to integrate all the station services with cloud services to serve our mobile platform
● Worked on dynamic weather based service for Volta’s Ad Platform
● Helped architect Volta’s Payments infrastructure to enable Charge for Charging
● Secured Volta’s station access using AWS IoT tunneler

Some technologies I work with :
- Node/Typescript, Python, C/C++
- Ubuntu, Yocto
- Docker, GitHub + CircleCI
-Kafka, MQTT

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Providing subject matter expertise for IAM practice
•	Responsible for development and successful execution of identity lifecycle events and access management
•	Working on obtaining a Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) authorization for selected products and services at the FedRAMP Moderate level
•	Responsible for development and successful execution of SailPoint IIQ based Access Reviews to meet the compliance requirements
•	Responsible for availability, security, administration, performance and monitoring of the IAM services

•	Automated build and deploy process using Jenkins
•	Developing and extending in house APIs for access management; increasing efficiency and reducing latency
•	Increased efficiency by automating employee On-Boarding and Off-Boarding process
•	Introduced automated access review process via. SailPoint IIQ for enterprise applications
•	Configuring SAML and OAuth2.0 based SSO for enterprise applications using PingFederate
•	Migrating SSO service from PingFederate to Azure AD
•	Securing access to enterprise applications with Duo multi-factor authentication
•	Responsible for maintaining proper codebase on GitHub and performing code reviews
•	Experience in containerization using Docker 

•	Supporting operations team in their troubleshooting efforts
•	Documenting technical designs, configurations and customizations of the IAM platform
•	Owning and maintaining the SailPoint IIQ code repository on GitHub
•	Working in an agile environment, creating user stories/bugs and track them as a part of the development process

positions.title: Software Engineer-Identity and Access Management
positions.description:
•	Planned and executed a successful SailPoint IIQ migration to AWS
•	Planned and executed a successful SailPoint IIQ upgrade from 7.0p8 to 7.3p1
•	Planned and executed a successful database migration from Oracle to MS SQL for SailPoint IIQ
•	Planned and executed successful database migration from on-prem MS SQL to AWS Aurora MySql

•	Managing the complete lifecycle of the user's identity and access in the enterprise
•	Developed custom webservices to integrate ServiceNow and SailPoint IIQ
•	Integrated 40+ enterprise applications including Workday, Active Directory, Service-Now, SAP, Salesforce, Ariba, Tableau, Heroku, Concur, Redshift etc. with SailPoint IIQ
•	Automated access provisioning/de-provisioning for enterprise applications and enhanced user experience by reducing the wait-time for access requests
•	Securing critical applications with Duo Multi-Factor Authentication
•	Configuring SAML and OAuth2.0 based SSO for enterprise applications using PingFederate
•	Administration, maintenance and monitoring of the Identity infrastructure

•	Reporting on daily matrices including number of logins, access requests, new hires and terminations
•	Documenting technical design, configuration, customization, creating run books
•	Working in an agile environment, creating user stories/bugs and track them as a part of the development process

positions.title: Engineer | Cloud Security and Identity & Acces Management
positions.description:
•	Account, access and group management in Okta using RESful APIs.
•	Configuration and support of various Okta features such as: Okta Desktop SSO (Kerberos/IWA), Multi-factor authentications with RSA
•	Coordinate with the Business, HR and other stakeholders to determine employee or third party/vendor level of access and status (manually or via automated workflows)

•	Assist with coordination and execution of user provisioning and general maintenance activities for Identity Management technology and application environments in the Wyndham Enterprise.
•	Automating account and access provisioning
•	Administration, maintenance and monitoring of Identity Management systems; including SailPoint IdentityIQ LifeCycle Manager, SailPoint IdentityIQ Compliance Manager, Okta and Oracle IDM Suite
•	Customization of the various identity management systems according with business specifications; customization includes workflows, aggregation, provisioning, and reconciliation rules in SailPoint and Oracle IDM and authentication rules in Okta
•	Document technical design, configuration, customization  and technical specification documents
•	Perform functional and technical requirements gathering and analysis for an enterprise wide identity and access management program

•	Oversee periodic compliance audits (i.e. access re-certification) in conjunction with risk and compliance management for PCI, SOX, PII and BCP/DR related systems.
•	Manage remediation activities in response to access re-certification, audit and/or assessment findings pertaining to inappropriate user access
•	Assist project teams with the design and implementation of user access roles at the application and technology infrastructure levels as necessary
•	Interface with information risk and compliance team to incorporate enterprise role design into system classifications and sensitivity as necessary

positions.title: Associate Engineer | SharePoint
positions.description:
• Provide 2nd tier support for SharePoint 2010/2013 environment of over 10K websites used by over 20K users daily
• Working through full software development lifecycle, from gathering requirements, designing solutions, deploying sites and code, conducting peer reviews and technical testing
• Developed custom SharePoint application involving custom .net workflow, timer job, event receivers
• Developed custom UI for SharePoint sites using HTML, CSS and JS
• Developed responsive dashboard for our custom SharePoint reporting application using charts.js, CSS3 and HTML5
• Helped develop custom solution to complete SharePoint tasks via. Email
• Developed event receiver to monitor site health and report back status when required via. Email
• Experience working with CSOM and SharePoint Web Services
• Experience in writing PowerShell scripts to move contents, list archival etc.
• Experience working with CAML queries, jQuery
• Teach a class on SharePoint Permissions and Introduction to SharePoint as a part of our User Training Program

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant

positions.title: Research Assistant

projects.title: Motion Learning for Humanoid Robots
projects.description:
- Project leader of the team responsible for teaching Darwin-op (Humanoid Robot) human motion and gestures
- Using Kinect sensor to get the coordinates values at different joint positions of a person and planning the trajectory of motion
- Developing algorithms for trajectory control using Inverse Kinematics
- Creating .motion files for servo control of the robot
- Implementing DMP (Dynamic Movement Primitives) techniques to adapt the movements of the robot according to the change in surroundings

projects.title: An All-purpose Hotel App (WYNApp)
projects.description:
- Developed a prototype android application as a part of an Innovation Project at Wyndham Worldwide
- An all purpose android application for the hotels of Wyndham with features like:
          - Switching Control
          - Door locking system control
          - Front Desk Help
          - Order amenities
          - Call a Cab
and much more at a push of a button
- Designed & Developed the UI for the application
- Also incorporated the features for reward points and discounts in the application
